display.purpose: Cover headline only, set over the indigo ground. Never used for a sentence.

headline.purpose: Every page title and the register panel title. Condensed heavy Archivo, balanced wrapping.

title.purpose: Stage names, index row titles, mode-switch tabs, footer column headings.

body.purpose: All running text, 0.75rem floor, measures between 44ch and 68ch. Spanish throughout.

label.purpose: Uppercase 11px Archivo eyebrows, field labels, and stamps. Announces a category, never a sentence.

numeral.purpose: Dates and counts in tabular figures so digits align on the ruling.

shadows.name: page
shadows.purpose: The only resting shadow. Every dark page and the register panel cast it onto the indigo ground.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: The top sheet only, while hovered or holding focus within: the page is picked up.

shadows.name: stack
shadows.purpose: A panel floating over other content on the ground rather than resting in the page; today only the mobile nav.

shadows.name: fox-glow
shadows.purpose: The fox image only. The only glow in the system, inherited from the legacy treatment.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: The single easing curve in the world. Every state transition and the mobile nav entrance use it.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Colour, transform and shadow transitions on buttons, tabs, fields and the grip.

motion.name: field
motion.purpose: Border and focus-ring transitions on inputs and the mode switch.

motion.name: sheet-lift
motion.purpose: The cover sheet lifting -10px with -0.35deg while hovered or focused within.

motion.name: grip-flip
motion.purpose: The lift grip chevron rotating 180deg when the sheet beneath is open.

motion.name: nav-stack
motion.purpose: The mobile nav dropdown entrance and exit.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: One block neutralises every animation and transition under prefers-reduced-motion, and removes the sheet lift transform while keeping its state.

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.note: Cover collapses to one column, page head stacks, fox scales to 340px.

breakpoints.name: mid
breakpoints.note: Tabs replaced by a 44px toggle, shell gutter to 32px, rows, columns, index and footer all collapse to one column.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.note: Page padding to 24px 20px 28px, margin rule to 16px, footer bottom padding to 40px.

components.name: Primary Button — Violet
components.description: The submit on indigo. Violet fill with abyss text; used full-width inside the register.

Kitsunova
El registroEl proceso

components.css: .ds-surface-ground { background: radial-gradient(circle at 14% -6%, #07186b, #020535 42%, #010114); padding: 28px; } .ds-card { background: linear-gradient(145deg, #0d1430, #0b1128); border: 1px solid rgba(124, 108, 255, 0.2); border-radius: 20px; padding: clamp(26px, 3.6vw, 46px); } .ds-index__row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 16px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 16px; padding: 22px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(124, 108, 255, 0.2); } .ds-index__row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-index__mark { position: relative; width: 12px; height: 12px; margin-top: 7px; border-radius: 2px; background: #3048d8; } .ds-index__mark::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 2px; background: #7c6cff; transform: translate(4px, 4px); } .ds-subhead { margin: 0; color: #ffffff; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 92, 'wght' 600; font-size: clamp(1.0625rem, 1.5vw, 1.1875rem); line-height: 1.24; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-index__row p { margin: 6px 0 0; color: #a9b4e0; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.6; max-width: 46ch; }

narrative.overview: The landing is a deep, near-black indigo identity executed with current craft: a radial gradient ground in violet-tinged indigo, violet and blue light on it, and exactly one bone light surface as punctuation. The density is clean and modern. There is no paper craft, no cut edges, no neumorphism. The hero is a deliberate two-column split — registration form on the left, headline and fox on the right — never overlapping. The fox carries the legacy violet-blue glow as the single deliberate glow in the system. Depth is conveyed through tonal layering and real offset shadows on the register panel and the liftable sheet, not through glow cards.
keyCharacteristics: Radial near-black indigo ground (radial-gradient(circle at 14% -6%, #07186b, #020535 42%, #010114)), fixed attachment.
Dark cards with a 1px violet hairline (rgba(124,108,255,0.2)) and linear-gradient(145deg, #0d1430, #0b1128).
One bone light surface (#f4f1ea) reserved for the record section; it is punctuation, not the base.
Accent hierarchy: violet #7c6cff dominant, blue #3048d8 deeper for secondary layers and scrollbar only, cyan #5ddcff reserved for focus rings.
Fox image with legacy drop-shadow(0 0 34px rgba(78,122,255,0.5)).
Hero composition: grid-template-columns: minmax(0,430px) minmax(0,1fr); form left, stage right.
prefers-reduced-motion neutralised in CSS and the framer-motion mobile nav reads useReducedMotion() and sets duration to 0.
Contrast verified numerically; no headless browser available, so no screenshot verification.

rules.name: The Accent Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Violet carries filled actions and selected states. Blue is structural and scroll-only. Cyan is attention-only (focus). No other accent hues exist.

rules.name: The One Glow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are offset and blur only. The fox is the only element that carries a glow, and it is a legacy filter, not a box-shadow.

rules.name: The One Shadow Per Surface Rule
rules.body: A dark surface gets either the page shadow or the lift shadow. It never gets both, and it never gets a second decorative shadow.

rules.name: The Condensed-Heavy Rule
rules.body: Archivo is for shapes, labels, numerals and headlines; running text is always Source Sans 3, and no sentence is ever set in Archivo.

rules.name: The 0.75rem Floor Rule
rules.body: Running text never drops below 0.75rem. Smaller sizes are uppercase Archivo labels or tabular numerals.

rules.name: The 26px Rhythm Rule
rules.body: Top-level sections inside <main> are separated by exactly 26px. Card padding scales with clamp(26px, 3.6vw, 46px).

dos: Do scope every new landing rule to a .kb-* class inside the .kb-root token scope, and define new values as CSS custom properties there, so the psychologist, user and admin surfaces keep their own world.
Do reserve deep blue for secondary layers and the scrollbar only, and cyan for focus rings only.
Do give a dark surface exactly one hairline border and one shadow only when it is the register panel or the liftable sheet.
Do set every date, count and numeral in tabular figures so the columns stay aligned.
Do mark state redundantly — colour plus label plus glyph plus position — so nothing depends on colour alone.
Do keep running text in Source Sans 3 at 0.75rem or larger, and cap every measure between 44ch and 68ch.
Do disable, rather than hide, what does not exist yet, and say so in the copy next to it.
Do label illustrative data as an example in the product itself, with a stamp and a footnote.
donts: Don't reintroduce neumorphism, paper craft, or cut edges. The ground is indigo, the cards are dark with hairline borders, and the only light surface is bone.
Don't reach for the legacy --neumorphic-*, --psy-* or --admin-* token scopes from inside this world; they belong to surfaces this landing does not govern.
Don't put a glow on the fox, a gradient on the bone, or a rim light on a cut edge. The fox glow is the only glow, and it is a filter.
Don't express progress as a percentage, a bar, a streak, an achievement counter or a locked tier. A tail is cut by a closed review, and a state change changes the page.
Don't encode state in colour alone, and don't let a colour be the only difference between two rows.
Don't invent metrics, testimonials, user counts, professional names or outcomes. The landing states what exists and says what does not.
Don't add a fourth breakpoint, a second font request, or a second @import.
Don't lift this world onto the user, psychologist or admin surfaces without a deliberate decision — they have their own, and this file does not describe them.
